verdict.rationale: LibreOffice's documented CLI conversion (--convert-to) and filter list cover office, graphics, EPUB and other document formats. The evidence never mentions extracting or repacking ZIP, 7z or RAR archives as part of a conversion. EPUB being a zip-based container is a document format, not archive handling, so it earns no credit.

support.subject: As a power user, archives (ZIP, 7z, RAR) extract and repack as part of a conversion
